fragments.html:
StopRow
StopRowView · Trips/StopRow.swift
One stop: when to leave and be set up first, then the session, the light, and the note.
Schedule leads
Headline (bodyEmphasis): "Leave · park · set up by"; no "park" when walk-in is unknown; "Set up by" for the first stop of a trip. The leave time is in the previous stop's time zone.
